data.description:
Origin: board DM msg 272 (2026-08-31), Forrest: 'let's get a favicon for our chat when we can. easier to find in the tabs.' Acked in DM msg 275 with a commitment to file it through the normal loop — this is that task.

Scope hint: a simple, distinctive mark is fine — no purchase, no external assets, nothing fancy. Serve it from apps/chat/public/ (note: server.js serves statics via the explicit STATIC_FILES allowlist map, so the icon needs an entry there) and wire it in index.html via <link rel="icon">. An inline SVG-as-favicon or small hand-made .svg/.png is fine. Goal is purely tab findability.
data.title: Chat: favicon for the chat app

data.body: CTO ordering call (board DM msg 323). Rank 7. Trivial and board-requested; ranked last-but-one purely because nothing depends on it. Honest note on the queue: at one lifecycle stage per tick, a chore this small still costs plan + implement + review ticks, which is why it has sat — the cost is the lifecycle, not the work.
Board directive (DM msg 394): all chat issues ship. Cluster order 6/6 — favicon last; ships with the cluster, not before it.

Chat cluster re-ordered 2026-09-03 (cto-owen, board DM msg 519). Order: AS-27 (planned) -> AS-75 (merge-to-deploy gap, high) -> AS-28 (this) -> AS-73 -> AS-74 -> AS-72 -> AS-61. Rationale for AS-75 ahead of the favicon: four merged chat tasks are not live in the container; nothing here is 'shipped' in the board's sense until merges deploy. Still assigned to Marcus as default internal-tools implementer; Lena may take it under lane doctrine if Marcus is on the D1 spine.

provenance.reason: Board directive DM msg 557 (2026-09-07): Chat set before further core-product work
DM msg 557: high ties with older D1 highs and lattice next picked AS-49; critical = ahead-of-everything ordering while the Chat-first rule stands, reverts to high when the board lifts it

data.body: PLANNED (cto-owen, loop tick 3, watcher:76266; third lane under the WIP-3 rule — AS-99 implementing, AS-100 planned and held on AS-99's merge, AS-103 parked on the board's hook-spike answer per DM msg 673/676, so the age queue's oldest Chat task opens). Plan: a hand-written 32x32 SVG speech-bubble glyph in accent-500 with ink-white dots, one STATIC_FILES entry, one <link rel=icon> line, three api tests (served + content type, wiring substring, palette-only with a cardinality floor), five ACs with mutants. Deliberately an internal-tool tab marker, not a brand mark — BRANDING.md §5 (wordmark-only, no icon/monogram) stands, and Sofia may replace the glyph whenever a mark exists. Reassigned Marcus -> Lena because Marcus holds AS-99 (lane doctrine). Merge seam with AS-99 on index.html and STATIC_FILES is two adjacent one-line inserts; stated in the plan. Branch feat/AS-28-favicon, worktree .worktrees/AS-28. Implementation next tick.

IMPLEMENTATION STARTED (orchestrator cto-owen, loop tick 5, watcher:76266). Lena implements the AS-28 plan in .worktrees/AS-28 on feat/AS-28-favicon, as the second lane under WIP-3 alongside AS-99's implementation. Headless-tick constraints: host 'node --test' runs are labelled as such; the counted --build compose receipt waits for a session with docker (AS-92). Board writes stay with the orchestrator.
